attchmntText: Satia Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Satia Industries Limited submitted an investor presentation to the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The company reported a net loss of INR 275 million for Q2 FY27, compared to a loss of INR 245 million in Q2 FY26. Revenue from operations declined by 11 percent year-on-year to INR 2,755 million. The presentation highlighted the completion of the renovation and modernization of Paper Machine 3 in September 2026. The company noted improved paper realizations but cited elevated raw material costs impacting profitability. Satia Industries has an installed capacity of over 200,000 MTPA and operates 16 cutlery units. The firm maintains a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.30 as of the first half of FY27.

attchmntText: Satia Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "INR 2755Mn Revenues in Q2FY 27".
voiceSummary: Satia Industries Limited reported revenues of INR 2,755 Mn for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. This represents an 11% year-on-year decline from INR 3,111 Mn in the corresponding period of the previous year. The company recorded a net loss of INR 275 Mn for the quarter. EBITDA stood at INR 61 Mn, down from INR 66 Mn in the same period last year. Gross margin was 40.1%. The decline in profitability was attributed to elevated input costs, particularly for agro-based raw materials like wheat straw. The company completed the renovation and modernisation of Paper Machine 3 towards the end of September 2026. Operations have resumed following this shutdown. The company opted for a concessional tax regime effective the current financial year.

attchmntText: Satia Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Satia Industries Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 2,748.96 Lakhs for the quarter, compared to a loss of 2,451.74 Lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 27,548.02 Lakhs. Earnings per share were negative 2.75 rupees. The statutory auditors, N Kumar Chhabra and Co., issued an unmodified opinion on the review report. The company noted a statutory impact of new Labour Codes as an exceptional item. It also adopted the concessional tax regime under Section 200 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, effective from the financial year 2026-27.
